settings.title_text: Fashion. Reimagined for the Intelligent Era.
settings.subtitle_text: At Volturia, we aim to redefine the dialogue between People and Fashion. We bring the precision and artistry of Couture into the world of Prêt-à-Porter, creating garments with an avant-garde vision and futuristic cuts that reflect a new kind of elegance.

settings.b2_text: Volturia blends avant-garde aesthetic with contemporary luxury for those seeking individuality. Made in Italy with artisanal craftsmanship (select pieces in Portugal), the brand follows the ethos "Avoid The Noise," inspiring authentic self-expression beyond convention.
settings.b4_text: We minimize fabric waste in prototyping by leveraging an innovative 3D software, allowing us to experiment and refine our collections efficiently.

settings.question: What is Volturia?
settings.answer: Volturia is an Italian luxury fashion brand that merges technology, quality and innovation into its own collections. All of this while being eco-friendly and transparent.

settings.question: How does the NFC Chip Work?
settings.answer: The Volturia NFC Chip works like magic: simply place your smartphone over the chip to instantly view the Digital Garment Passport for your piece. The first time you use it, you will be asked if you want to permanently register the garment on the Blockchain. Once registered, the garment becomes uniquely yours, verifiable at any time, and linked to exclusive contents and promotions accessible only to its owner.

settings.question: What is the Virtual Try-On?
settings.answer: The Volturia Virtual Try-On transforms the way you shop. At checkout, you can see exactly how the garments you’ve selected will fit your body. Simply create a personalized avatar with your exact measurements (no personal photos required) and try the pieces on digitally. This ensures a perfect fit, eliminates returns, and reduces logistical waste, keeping both the planet and our customers happy!

settings.question: Are garments really sustainable?
settings.answer: Yes, Volturia garments are eco-sustainable. Our producers follow strict standards OEKO-TEX, GOTS, Organic Blended Content, and Global Recycled Standard - ensuring safe, organic, recycled, and environmentally responsible production.

settings.question: I missed a drop, what now?
settings.answer: Our drops are strictly limited, once sold out, they’re gone. The only chance to secure a piece afterward is if any remaining items become available later, follow Volturia via socials to always stay updated.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer:
We currently ship with DHL Express to the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, the United Kingdom and Ireland.
Estimated delivery times are 24–48 hours within Europe, the UK, and Ireland.
2–3 business days for the US and Canada and 3–5 business days for Japan.

settings.question: Can I return/exchange an item?
settings.answer: Yes, we have a 14 days return policy.

settings.subtitle_text: Can't find yours? Just send us an e-mail to contact@volturia.com
